## Setup {#sec-setup}

The agent sees a state $s_t$ and picks an action $a_t$, as in @mnih2015.

## Value of a state {#sec-value}

The value of a state is the expected discounted sum of the rewards that follow it [@sutton2018, ch. 3]. @eq-value defines it, and @sec-settings gives the settings.

$$
V(s_t) = \mathbb{E}\Big[\sum_{k \ge 0} \gamma^k\, r_{t+k+1}\Big]
$$ {#eq-value}

::: {.callout-note}
The game ends after $T$ steps, or earlier when the agent loses.
:::

## Settings {#sec-settings}

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Learning rate | $3 \times 10^{-4}$ |
| Batch size | 256 |
| Target update | every 1000 steps |

: Training settings {#tbl-settings}

The values in @tbl-settings are the defaults.
